text:
Emma J: Hey team — kicking off the Melbourne (au-southeast-2) marketplace onboarding with CloudFast + EdgeNode. Need capacity/quota request, KMS plan, and a go-live announcement timeline.

Rio - CloudFast: Thanks Emma — CloudFast can provide a managed image and 8x A100-equivalent instances in region, plus an edge pool from EdgeNode for low-latency reads.

Ben I: Nice. What exact instance SKUs do we need to request from AWS? Also expected QPS/peak tokens so infra can size autoscale.

Emma J: For initial sizing request: 8x p4d-like (we'll accept p4dn or compatible), 12x g5. Estimate 10k requests/day, peak 300 r/s, avg 350 tokens/request, plan for 2x headroom.

Rio - CloudFast: Confirmed — we'll hold 10x spare GPUs for burst. We'll also upload AMI to marketplace once KMS + entitlement approved.

Ben I: Cool. I'll file quota tickets but need the marketplace SKU id and the account numbers that will own the reserved capacity. Also KMS key ARN for encrypting images.

Emma J: Marketplace SKU: CF-MEL-LLM-1 (partner-proposed). Owner account: 987654321000. KMS key: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:987654321000:key/abcd-ef01-2345.

ops-bot: Capacity request created — ticket CF-4821. Assigned to @Ben I. ETA for quota response ~72h.

Ben I: Filing now, adding required attachments (cost projection, expected token throughput). Also hooking up the autoscaler policy: recommended min=2, max=20 per pool.

Sophie L: Quick legal flag — because imagery and some telemetry may hit partner systems, we need a DPA addendum and a one-page data flow diagram for the Melbourne launch. Can Marketing/Sales confirm customer-facing wording about data residency?

Anya S: We should say "Customer data stored in-region in Melbourne and encrypted with partner-managed keys" — Sophie, will that work? We'll avoid naming specific partners in the public docs until contracts are final.

Sophie L: That language is OK but we need contract sign-off on partner-managed KMS before public statement. Please route to legal via Zendesk with partner contact.

Emma J: Noted. I'll create the legal ticket and attach the partner SOC docs and KMS acceptance.

Ben I: For infra handoff, here's a quick terraform snippet to create the entitlement role we asked for:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_entitlement" {
  name = "cf_marketplace_entitlement_role"
  assume_role_policy = file("assume_policy.json")
}
```
Attach this to the partner marketplace account (987654321000) and grant sts:AssumeRole to our deployment pipeline.

Rio - CloudFast: We'll confirm role creation today and provide the role ARN.

Emma J: Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: quota + IAM role + KMS paperwork in flight
- Day 3–4: image upload + internal smoke tests
- Day 7: canary to ~5% traffic (customers flagged)
- Day 14: public announcement (subject to legal & partner sign-off)

Anya S: Can Marketing prep an announcement draft by Day 5? Also need joint press contact from CloudFast.

Rio - CloudFast: Will share partner PR contact and a short 2-paragraph partner blurb by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: CF-4821 status updated: AWS quota ticket created (AQ-90077). Estimated quota increase: 32 GPU instances.

Ben I: Once quota is approved I'll provision a staging pool and run the perf harness. Can someone provision the test dataset in S3 with encryption?

Emma J: I'm on S3 upload. Will encrypt with the partner KMS key and share bucket ARN in this thread.

Sophie L: Legal ticket created: ZD-11590 (DPA addendum + KMS confirmation). Emma, add partner SOC docs.

Rio - CloudFast: SOC docs uploaded to shared drive and link posted to the Zendesk ticket.

Emma J: Bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::cf-mel-testing-211234 (encrypted). I added a short README for validators.

Ben I: Great — once quota comes in I'll kick off the perf run and tag results here.

Anya S: Locking proposed announcement week: 2026-04-12 (tentative) — if legal and quota align.

Emma J: Thanks all. I'll track actions in the partner onboarding checklist and ping daily until green. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: CF-4821 updated: Quota approved by AWS (AQ-90077) — increase granted. Please verify resources in console.
